Name in Other Languages

Peaceful Dove Bun (Korean: 평화의 비둘기 만쥬, pyeonghwaui bidulgi manjyu, "Manjū Dove of Peace") is an Epic Treasure released alongside Cotton Candy Cookie during the Grand Champions League update. It creates a Peaceful Jelly after running a certain distance without collision.

  • 1 Story

  • 3 Changelog
  • 4 Trivia

Story

Gently carrying an olive branch in its beak, this Peaceful Dove Bun glides through the air bestowing peace and happiness on all the Cookies.

Skill

Peaceful Dove Bun's Skill
Run without collisions for some time to make the Peaceful Dove Bun appear and reward you. Level Up for more points for Peaceful Jellies.
Level Skill
1 Pigeons appear if there is no collision while running the distance of 2,990px
+804,0000 pts for Peaceful Jellies
12 Pigeons appear if there is no collision while running the distance of 2,990px
+1,530,000 pts for Peaceful Jellies
Enhanced Effect
Level Skill
6 +270,000 pts for Peaceful Jellies

Changelog

  • Mystery on the SS Cargot - October 14, 2025
    • Increased points for Peaceful Jellies.
  • Mystery on the SS Cargot - September 25, 2025
    • Points no longer shown when collecting Peaceful Jellies.
  • Rise of the Blue Dragon - April 27, 2023
    • Greatly reduced distance required for skill activation.
    • Reduced points for Peaceful Jellies.
    • Reduced Combi point bonus.
  • The Witch's Mystic Attic - February 14, 2022
    • Combi Bonus added with Crowberry Cookie.
    • Skill activation changed to be based on distance traveled rather than time passed.
    • Increased points for Peaceful Jellies.
  • The Witch's Mystic Attic - January 27, 2022
    • Combi Bonus added with Cotton Candy Cookie.

Trivia

  • Peaceful Dove Bun's name reflects on the established symbolism of doves, which are known to symbolize peace, freedom, or love.
    • The last symbol might also be the reason why it was released alongside Cotton Candy Cookie.
  • The Korean and Japanese names for the Peaceful Dove Bun states that the dove is made out of manjū (饅頭), which is a traditional Japanese confection consisting of a sweet outer dough filled with various ingredients such as red bean paste, sesame paste, or chestnut paste.
